_about: Cheat sheet of each policymaker's stated rate views, for the Summary on the dashboard's CB commentary page. Written by the scheduled labelling task (and by hand); keyed 'Bank|Name' as in speakers.json. Only what the person has actually said, paraphrased; leave a field empty rather than guess. Fields: votes {year: true/false} for yearly rotations (Fed), or {"YYYY-MM-DD": true/false} per meeting where the vote rotates meeting by meeting (ECB governors) - a meeting date wins over a year; stance hawk|lean hawk|centre|lean dove|dove (their own rate view, not market impact); next / following {call, note} for the next two rate-setting meetings - call is one of '+50', '+25 or +50', '+25', 'hike' (wants a hike, size not said), 'hold or +25', 'hold', '-25', 'open', '' (no view given); how = 'said' (they named this meeting or the move), 'implied' (follows from what they said, e.g. 'more hikes soon' or 'at least two more', without naming the meeting), or 'vote' (from their latest vote or minutes explanation); path {total, by, note} = the total move they want from here and by when, if they said; view = 1-2 sentences on their view of rates now; shift = how their view has changed recently; last = date of their last remark on rates (YYYY-MM-DD), ev = where; basis verbatim|reports; conf high|medium|low = how clearly they have said it; asof = when this entry was last reviewed. quote / qsrc (on next and following): their own words that support the call, at most 12 words copied exactly from the remark or from a headline reporting it, with where and when (e.g. 'headline (Bloomberg), Nov 10'); required when how is 'said', welcome for 'implied' and 'vote'.

Fed.note: Votes: 2026 = governors, Williams, Hammack, Logan, Kashkari, Paulson. From January 2027 the rotating seats pass to Goolsbee (Chicago), Barkin (Richmond), Daly (San Francisco) and the Atlanta Fed president (interim: Cheryl Venable). Oct 28 hold was 10-2, Cook and Hammack dissenting for a 25bp hike. Warsh gives no forward guidance.

ECB.note: The six Executive Board members always vote; national governors rotate monthly. Not voting in December: Netherlands (Sleijpen), Belgium (Wunsch), Bulgaria, Slovenia (Dolenc), Slovakia and Finland (Rehn). The 2027 rotation is not published yet, so February counts the Executive Board only. Lagarde announced on Oct 29 that she is leaving early (in February). Held at 2.50% on Oct 29 after hiking in September.

BoE.note: All nine MPC members vote at every meeting. Nov 5: hiked to 4.00% by 8-1, Mann voting for 50bp. Views below lean on each member's own explanation in the November minutes plus later remarks.

BoC.note: The Governing Council decides by consensus and publishes no individual votes, so everyone counts as deciding. Hiked to 2.50% on Oct 28; the summary of deliberations said further hikes may be needed. Macklem will not seek a second term (ends June 2027).

SNB.note: The three-member Governing Board decides by consensus at quarterly assessments. Policy rate 0%; the SNB says it would intervene in FX or even return to negative rates if needed, though the bar is higher.
